verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is that Triage can deliver the PR queue as a scheduled Slack digest. That is a narrow, preset recurring delivery, not user-defined recurring jobs or workflows. Every other automation in the pack (auto-review, CI failure analysis, finishing touches) is triggered by events or commands, not by a schedule. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of recurring reviews, scans, or custom recipes (e.g. cron-style triggers), docs on configuring schedules, independent corroboration.
